name: constellation-monorepo
description: Monorepo orchestrator for Constellation (client: React, server: Express) — scripts to run, build and test both packages
author: Constellation Team

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server run build || echo "No server build script defined"
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm --prefix server run lint || true" "npm --prefix client run lint || true"
scripts.validate-engines: node -e "const v=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(v[0]<18) throw new Error('Node >=18 is required'); console.log('Node OK:', process.version)"
